title: guardrails/sandbox security profile
description: One agent tool-execution security profile (restricted / standard / privileged). Isolation knobs adapted from the elevatedIQ ai-chatbot-orchestrator sandbox pattern (spike #48): read-only rootfs, no-new-privileges, dropped Linux capabilities, network mode, run user, and CPU / memory / PID / timeout quotas. cpuQuota is the Linux CFS quota in microseconds per 100 ms period (50000 = 50% of one core).

noNewPrivs.description: no_new_privs is set; privilege escalation inside the sandbox is refused.

capDrop.description: Linux capabilities dropped ("ALL" drops every capability).

networkMode.description: none blocks all network; bridge grants a private bridge; host shares the host network.

cpuQuota.description: CFS CPU quota in microseconds per 100 ms period.
